description: Get all lounges in a specific lounge network. Returns every lounge that accepts a particular network membership (e.g. all Priority Pass lounges worldwide). Pass airport to limit the results to one airport, e.g. the Priority Pass lounges at Heathrow.

airport.description: Optional airport IATA code (e.g. JFK, LHR). Only lounges at this airport are returned.

network.description: Network slug (e.g. priority-pass, loungekey, dragonpass, plaza-premium, amex-centurion, diners-club, star-alliance, skyteam, oneworld, aspire)

name: get_network_lounges
title: Lounges in a network
